title: Storyboard
description: The contract between every pipeline stage. v1 holds the story and narration; later stages add their own fields.

narration_language.description: BCP-47 code of the spoken language, e.g. "am" for Amharic. Subtitles are always English.

translation_notes.description: Extra instructions for the translator, e.g. tense or tone that English leaves implicit.

voices.description: One TTS voice per speaker. Every line's speaker must appear here.

voice.description: Gemini TTS prebuilt voice name, e.g. "Algenib".

style.description: The look, added word for word to every image prompt so it never drifts.

motion_style.description: Added to every motion prompt, to stop the video model drifting away from the keyframes' look.

video_engine.description: Which image-to-video engine's clips go into the film.

music.description: One score cue for the whole film. The music stage makes one candidate per seed; `chosen_seed` picks the one assembly uses.

caption.description: Style, mood, instruments, texture. Keep tempo and key out of it.

end_card.description: Text of the closing card. The model credits are filled in from runs.jsonl.

made_by.description: The human behind the film, shown above the model credits.

characters.description: Recurring characters. Each gets a reference image that every keyframe showing them is conditioned on.

description.description: Fixed visual description, reused in every prompt.

id.description: Stable id used in output file names and caches. Never renumber.

reason.description: Why this shot exists, in one sentence.

description.description: What the viewer sees, in plain words.

duration_s.description: Planned length. Assembly may stretch it to fit the narration.

characters.description: Ids from the top-level `characters` that appear in this shot (at most 4: the image model takes 4 references).

image_prompt.description: What the keyframe shows: place, action, framing. The style and character descriptions are added automatically.

motion_prompt.description: Image-to-video prompt: only the motion and the camera. The keyframe already holds the subject and place.

vertical.description: How the 9:16 version frames this shot: `crop` a 9:16 slice at `focus` (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge), or `fit` the whole 16:9 frame over a blurred copy of itself, for shots with story on both sides.

clip_s.description: Length of the generated clip in seconds. Wan 2.2 makes 5 or 8; Grok Imagine makes 1 to 15. The shots stage refuses a clip too short for its shot's narration.

lines.description: Spoken lines in order. An empty list means a silent shot.

en.description: English text. Used for subtitles and as the translation source.

spoken.description: Text in narration_language. Filled by the script stage; a hand edit here is kept.

spoken_from_en.description: The English text that `spoken` was translated from. If `en` changes, the line is translated again.
